note: Targets for tools/balance.mjs (Soak class unless stated). Ranges are inclusive.

lapMeanSoak.note: Mean lap time (s) of the Soak field with items on, after the S1-04 thrust and the S1-01 wall retune (12 races per course). A run more than the tolerance away from these misses. Before the retune (6 races): bathhouse-row 54.87, bridge-street 54.06, goat-rock-gulpha 56.14, hs-mountain 53.38, park-avenue 54.66, sunset-ridge 54.50, west-mountain 56.60, whittington-valley 54.16.

botPlace.note: Mean finishing place (1 to 8) of the --bot driver (skill 1.02 at Soak pace in every class, uses its items) starting last on the grid, 24 races on bathhouse-row (S3-07). Measured before and after wave 3 (Splash 3.3 and 3.0, Soak 5.6 and 5.5, Scald 7.0 and 7.0, Boil 7.3 and 6.7); the bands are about one place either side, and the worst allowed place rises with the class.
